crossRefs.note: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die.…
She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean…
It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall…
“But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’
For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the…
For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
Abstain from every form of evil.
Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

translations.web: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
translations.bsb: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink. He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.
translations.kjv: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
translations.asv: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.
